d: Rashtriy janta dal (RJD) ke rashtriy adhyaksh lalu prasad yadav ek purane aachar sanhita ullanghan ke mamle men bihar ke sivan jile ki adalat men pesh hone pahunche. kort men kanuni prakriyaon ko pura karne ke turant bad lalu prasad yadav ka kaphila purv bahubli sansad marhum mohammad shahabuddin ke paitrik aavas ke lie ravana huaa.
